output.note: Subject premium composition is the caller's responsibility -- this kernel does not compute manual premium from payrolls and rates, and never vendors or reproduces NCCI or state rate tables. Out of scope: premium discount, expense constant, terrorism/catastrophe surcharges, state taxes, schedule rating and assigned-risk surcharge. The NCCI algorithm does not apply in the monopolistic state funds (Ohio, North Dakota, Washington, Wyoming) or the Puerto Rico and USVI funds.
output.regulatory_basis: NCCI Basic Manual premium algorithm as published by the Indiana Compensation Rating Bureau (Premium Algorithms): add to manual premium all premium items subject to experience rating to get total subject premium, then apply the experience modification to arrive at the modified premium; premiums shown to the nearest dollar, a remainder of $0.50 or more rounded to the next higher dollar (WCRB Wisconsin Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Basic Manual, Whole Dollars - Premiums).
